title: Cube Failures by Cube
app: Cube API query logs and Cube Store metrics via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=cube:api status="error"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by cube_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Cube failures grouped by cube so operators immediately see which specific cubes are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Cube is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Cube failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical cubes.
visualization: Table of cube by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Cube are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
